Would've gone trade in. New-ish vehicles shouldn't have such big issues. My dad had a chevy terrain it it was pure crap. Lucky they took it after a few warrantee repairs and he got a Ram. REALLY like the Ram. Looks nice inside out. All the tech, 4x2 so it has a very sporty ride, I like how it handles, should be at least 100lbs lighters. All color front (no chrome) and dual scoop hood is the best looking front end combo of all models. RAMBOX is full of win! You can fit exactly a case of beer and a bad of ice in this little bucket it has, even has a drain. That said, I'm intrigued by the new light duty diesel. Gas v8 has decent economy but if that diesel is anything like the MB 2.5td it should haul and save gas.

I'd have put a used engine in it, then traded it in when we get back to FL. That's the most logical thing to do. Spend 4k and end up with a 10k trade in vs 2-3k trade in with the blown engine. And I'd trade it in asap, before the value drops any more. I can't believe there've been so many problems with this thing. It's a 2009 with 70k miles and it was like $35k. ~15k of those mile are from driving back and forth to Florida, so it's really a pretty low use vehicle. J-U-N-K

In the end, we're still gonna have the same car, with the same problems, just with a new engine. I told him all of this.. makes no difference. I learned through all of my googling that there are other problems the car normally has.

Like the steering rack - which this car already has a problem with.

There's also this propane smell - which this car has. GM makes a vent kit that routes the transmission vent to the back of the car to fix the problem, because the heat/ac sucks in the smell unless you have the recirculation on. It's a HUGE job. Have to drop the transfer case, exhaust, gas tank. They might fix that for free under a good will policy. For months, I was wondering why Florida smelled like propane everywhere I went. smh

Then there's the switches. the right rear window switch won't put the window up, only down. The drivers switch for the right front window doesn't work 98% of the time up or down.

Then the speakers. I know I talked about how they worked intermittently. Like there was a short somewhere in the car. All four would work or not work, independent of each other. Fixed that with the new components. Only after ripping out the entire interior of the car looking for the short.

Car is such a piece of shit. The ONE thing that I always said I liked about the car was the engine... yeah. Not any more.

oh yeah... and then there's the issue where I go to get out of the car and the power won't go off. It has that delay where the power for the radio, windows, etc stays on til you open the door. Well, that doesn't work all the time. Sometimes I have to power it on/off a few times, sometimes start it, sometimes actually move it... before the power go off.

There was also the time when I first started driving it. I parked it in the driveway with really low gas and apparently it like to keep the fuel system pressurized (I'm guessing)... but since the driveway has an angle, the pump wasn't picking up fuel all night and ran the battery dead... fuck I hate this thing.
